_doc: Our own town walls' look (KitLook.Wall, kit.gdshader OWN_WALL; E9b1): each house's plaster tint (by its number in props_own.json walls.houses, 0-5) and timber tint (0-2, the tint's number mod 3), sRGB multipliers on the trim sheet's near-white plaster and grey-brown timber; the weathering: grime_h (m above the house's ground) and grime_dark (how much darker at the ground), splash_h and splash_dark (rain off the street), house_rise (the ground storey darker as a whole), stain_dark (streaks under sills), val_noise (broad patches), house_val (each house lighter or darker), occl (the baked occlusion's reach).
